observations.result: Plugin policy and fixture-runner tests pass; mediated reads are allowed, preview writes are staged, and direct write/filesystem/network/process/credential/privileged DOM capabilities are denied with visible D15 records.
The 25 mandatory plugin artifacts plus Minimal and Text Extractor remain pinned and marked planned until unchanged-artifact runtime certification.
No issues in the changed implementation and fixture-runner files.

implemented: PluginPolicy has no trusted legacy mode and returns visible unsupported-security records for every direct privileged capability.
PreviewBroker requires explicit approval before a plugin-originated change reaches VaultStore.
Capability and first-open-write probes are executable locally before any full plugin UI investment.
limitations: Unchanged upstream plugin bundles have not been loaded into a compatibility runtime; PLUG-009 and the PC01-PC25 certification matrix remain pending.
Bypass attempts have only run on local macOS arm64; Windows/Linux OS and renderer DOM traces remain pending.
No D15 requirement is release-passing: unsupported-security is only valid after reproducible artifact-specific evidence and all safe alternatives are recorded.
